en: The Question on the Calculation of Years
“How many years old are you, venerable Nāgasena?
“But what are those seven, venerable sir? Are you seven, or is it the number seven?”
Now at that time, the shadow of King Milinda—adorned with all his ornaments and fully arrayed in finery—was visible upon the earth and was also visible in a water-jar.
Then the Venerable Nāgasena said this to King Milinda:
“Great King, this shadow of yours is seen upon the earth and in the water-jar; but tell me, Great King, are you the king, or is the shadow the king?”
“Venerable Nāgasena, I am the king; this shadow is not the king, but it exists depending upon me.
“In the same way, Great King, the counting of the years is seven, but I am not seven; rather, the number seven exists depending upon me.
It is like a shadow, Great King. “It is wonderful, venerable Nāgasena! It is marvelous, venerable Nāgasena! These questions and answers have been resolved with such great ingenuity.”
The second question on counting the rains.
